description_en: Calls an API that is created in Data Service
description_zh: 对数据服务中已创建的API进行调用
name: QueryData

parameters.help_en: The API ID in Data Service. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144980.html
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en:
The user ID in Quick BI. For information about how to obtain the user ID, see QueryUserInfoByAccount (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/quickbi-public/2022-01-01/QueryUserInfoByAccount).
This parameter specifies the identity of the user who uses Data Service. You can use it in combination with the row-level and column-level permission configurations of the dataset.



<notice>If this parameter is not specified, an empty string is passed, or null is passed, the user ID of the owner of the current Quick BI organization is used by default.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
Quick BI中的userId。如何获取userId，请参见：根据账号查询用户信息接口 (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/quickbi-public/2022-01-01/QueryUserInfoByAccount)
该参数用于指定具体使用数据服务的人的身份，可结合数据集的行列权限配置使用



<notice>参数不传、传空字符串、传null等情况，默认传入的userId为当前Quick BI组织的owner></notice>
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions for Data Service. Pass the conditions as key-value pairs in a map-type string. The key is the request parameter name, and the value is the request parameter value. Keys and values must appear in pairs.

Note:

When the operator of the request parameter is set to Enumeration Filter, the value can contain multiple values. In this case, the value must be a JSON-formatted list. Example: `area=["East China","North China","South China"]`.     

For dates, different input formats are provided based on the date type:

    - Year: 2019

    - Quarter: 2019Q1

    - Month: 201901 (with a leading zero)
    
    - Week: 2019-52

    - Day: 20190101

    - Hour: 14:00:00 (minutes and seconds are 00)
    
    - Minute: 14:12:00 (seconds are 00)

    - Second: 14:34:34
parameters.help_zh:
数据服务的查询条件，以Key和Value的形式传入。map类型的字符串。其中，Key为请求参数的参数名，Value为请求参数的参数值。Key和Value必须成对出现。

说明：

请求参数的操作符设置为枚举筛选时支持value包含多个值，此时value值的格式是JSON形式的List。例如： `area=["华东","华北","华南"] `     

对于日期，根据类型不同，提供不同的入参格式：

    - 年：2019

    - 季：2019Q1

    - 月：201901  （携带0）
    
    - 周：2019-52

    - 日：20190101

    - 时：14:00:00 （分、秒为00）
    
    - 分：14:12:00 （秒为00）

    - 秒：14:34:34
parameters.name: conditions

parameters.help_en: The list of names of the returned parameters. The value is a list-type string
parameters.help_zh: 返回参数的参数名列表，List 类型字符串
parameters.name: return_fields

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the API. Valid values:

true: The execution is successful.
false: The execution fails
Result.description_zh:
返回接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败

Aggregator.description_en:
The aggregation operator. This field is available only for measure fields, such as SUM, AVG, and MAX. Valid values:
SUM: sum
MAX: maximum value
MIN: minimum value
AVG: average value
COUNT: count
COUNTD: deduplicate count
STDDEV_POP: population standard deviation
STDDEV_SAMP: sample standard deviation
VAR_POP: population variance
VAR_SAMP: sample variance
Aggregator.description_zh:
聚合操作符。度量字段才会有，例如SUM、AVG和MAX。
SUM：求和
MAX：最大值
MIN：最小值
AVG：平均值
COUNT：计数
COUNTD：去重计数
STDDEV_POP：总体标准差
STDDEV_SAMP：样本标准差
VAR_POP：样本标准差
VAR_SAMP：样本方差

Column.description_en: The field name, which corresponds to the field name in the physical table
Column.description_zh: 字段名，对应物理表字段名

DataType.description_en:
The data type of the field. Valid values:
number: numeric
string: string
date: date
time: time
datetime: date and time
DataType.description_zh:
字段的数据类型。一般有：
number：数值
string：字符串
date：日期
time：时间
datetime：日期时间

Granularity.description_en:
The granularity of the dimension field. This field is returned only when the requested field is a date dimension or geographic dimension field. Valid values:

Date granularity: yearRegion (year), monthRegion (month), weekRegion (week), dayRegion (day), hourRegion (hour), minRegion (minute), and secRegion (second).

Geographic granularity: COUNTRY (country level), PROVINCE (province level), CITY (city level), XIAN (district/county level), and REGION (region level)
Granularity.description_zh:
维度字段的粒度。
当请求字段为日期维度或地理维度字段，才会返回该字段，取值范围：

日期粒度：yearRegion（年）、 monthRegion（月）、weekRegion（周）、dayRegion（日）、hourRegion（时）、minRegion（分）、secRegion（秒）

地理信息粒度：COUNTRY（"国际级"）、PROVINCE（"省级"）、CITY（"市级"）、XIAN（"区县"）、REGION（"区域"）

Label.description_en: The alias of the field. It is used as the key of the map data row in the Values parameter
Label.description_zh: 字段别名，结果参数values中map数据行的key

OriginalColumn.description_en: The original name of the corresponding field in the dataset
OriginalColumn.description_zh: 数据集里对应的字段原名

Type.description_en:
The field type, which is used to distinguish whether the field is a dimension or a measure. Valid values:
Dimension: dimension
Measure: measure
Type.description_zh:
字段类型，用于区分是字段类型为维度或度量字段。
Dimension：维度
Measure：度量

Sql.description_en:
The SQL statement of the query.
In addition to the parameter conditions passed in the current API, the filter conditions in the returned SQL statement also include the row-level and column-level permission configurations
Sql.description_zh:
请求查询的 SQL。
返回的sql语句中的过滤条件除了当前接口的传参条件外，还会带上行列权限的配置信息
Sql.example: SELECT COMPANY_T_1_.`area` AS D_AREA_2_, COMPANY_T_1_.`city` AS D_CITY_3_, SUM(COMPANY_T_1_.`profit_amt`) AS D_PROFIT_4_ FROM `quickbi_test`.`company_sales_record_copy` AS COMPANY_T_1_ WHERE COMPANY_T_1_.`area` LIKE '%test%' GROUP BY COMPANY_T_1_.`area`, COMPANY_T_1_.`city` HAVING SUM(COMPANY_T_1_.`order_amt`) > 1 LIMIT 0, 10

items.description_en:
The rows and columns of the returned data.

This parameter uses a List<Map> structure, where each map represents a row of data. The key in the map corresponds to the Label field in Headers
items.description_zh:
返回数据的行和列。

此参数为List<Map>结构，每个Map即一行数据。其中Map中的Key对应 Headers#Label字段

ValuesV2.description_en: The returned query results, including the original value fields
ValuesV2.description_zh: 返回查询到的结果，带原始值字段

L.description_en: The field alias set in Data Service
L.description_zh: 数据服务中设置的字段别名

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
